text.title: Go Error Handling (AppError + Centralised Mapper) Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to produce a Go Error Handling (AppError + Centralised Mapper) artefact from typed inputs.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `goeh-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/go-error-handling.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

section.title: Implementation sub-procedure (expands steps 3 and 5 when the artefact ships real code)

step.name: scaffold-apperror-pkg
step.action: Drop `templates/apperror.go` into `pkg/apperror/`. Implement `Error()`, `Unwrap()`, constructors (NewNotFound, NewBadRequest, NewConflict, NewInternal) and `Wrap`.
step.decision-gate: If the team prefers `internal/` over `pkg/`, place it there — but apperror is intentionally exportable.

step.name: define-wrap-rules
step.input: Layer list (handler, service, repository) + their typical errors.
step.action: Document the wrap rule per boundary: repository wraps with `%w` and maps driver errors; service wraps with `%w` and adds context; handler returns the error unwrapped.
step.decision-gate: If a layer has no useful context to add, do not wrap — plain `return err`.

step.name: repository-boundary-mapping
step.input: Driver list (pgx, database/sql, redis, HTTP client).
step.action: Write one mapping function per driver in `internal/repository/errors.go`: `pgx.ErrNoRows` → NewNotFound; uniqueness violation → NewConflict; and so on.
step.output: One mapping function per driver in `repository/errors.go`.
step.decision-gate: If a driver exposes no stable sentinels (custom RPC client), match on code strings and document the choice.

step.name: wire-middleware
step.action: Drop `templates/error_middleware.go` (Gin) or `templates/error-middleware-stdlib.go` (net/http) into `internal/middleware/`. Register in order: RequestID, Recovery, Logger, ErrorMapper.
step.decision-gate: Recovery MUST come before ErrorMapper. Reversed order makes every panic a blank 500.

step.name: lint-gate
step.action: Enable errorlint, wrapcheck, errcheck, nilnil. Run on every PR.
step.decision-gate: Block the merge on any finding from this set.

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact
